name: rig-telemetry
description: Workstation telemetry stack, and the skills to read it.

plugins.name: rig-telemetry
plugins.description: Diagnose a loaded Linux workstation from recorded telemetry: split the load average into CPU and IO, attribute it to a named process group or docker compose stack, cap a runaway development environment, tell whether the machine's cooling has degraded, and price what every AI coding harness on it used at published API rates.
